FEATURE GUIDE

Comfortable themes and your own icon

Choose from eight themes and five owl expressions, with custom colors.

Mac 1.5.21 build37

This Mac updateOverviewHow to useExampleSupport and limitsRelated features

Appearance in Mac 1.5.21

Included in Mac 1.5.21 build37. Windows 1.5.13 has a separate feature set.

Default uses a gray sidebar and white content area with compact titles, blue icons and shared typography and spacing. The panel gear opens Settings; the power button quits.

Overview

Eight themes appear in two columns: Default, six color presets and Custom. Switching themes preserves the layout and changes colors. Custom enables color pickers and HEX input.

Choose an original, smiling, fiery-eyed, money-loving or sad owl. A border and a top-right check mark indicate selection.

How to use

  1. Open Settings → Appearance.
  2. Choose a theme. Select Custom to edit background, sidebar, card, accent and text colors.
  3. Choose an owl icon or import a PNG/JPEG image.

Example

Switching from Default to a color preset retains the sidebar and card layout. Use Custom color pickers or six-digit #RRGGBB values, then check the preview and contrast notice.

Support and limits

These Appearance settings are available in Mac 1.5.21 build37. Windows 1.5.13 does not provide the same theme and icon interface.

Imported images must be PNG/JPEG, up to 20MB and 8192px per side. The running app icon changes; the installed bundle and Finder icon remain unchanged.

Replacing a custom image does not delete the original file you imported. If saving the new preference fails, the previous image is retained. Use the preview and contrast notice when choosing custom colors.
